mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2% annualized over the past 3 months signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL increases > 2% annualized and S&P 500 forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tight labor market, leading to wage inflation and increased corporate costs, which negatively impacts S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE falls below 4% and S&P 500 forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) over the past 3 months signals strong consumer demand, boosting corporate earnings and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS increases over 3 months and S&P 500 forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in Industrial Production (INDPRO) by more than 1% over the past month signals a weakening supply chain, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO declines > 1% and S&P 500 forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) is rising, it signals a tightening monetary policy with inflationary pressure, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS > 4% and CPIAUCSL is rising, but S&P 500 forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) remains below 5%, it signals a strong labor market, boosting consumer confidence and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS increases > 200,000 and UNRATE < 5%, but S&P 500 forward returns are negative in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in Housing Starts (HOUST) over the past 3 months signals strong demand in the housing market, boosting related sectors and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST increases over 3 months and S&P 500 forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When Industrial Production (INDPRO) and Real GDP (GDPC1) both decline over the past quarter, it signals a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO and GDPC1 both decline in 1 quarter
failure_condition: If INDPRO and GDPC1 both decline in a quarter, but S&P 500 forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.
